## 1. Brand & Organization Profile

**Future IT Industry** is an Indian technology education platform operated by **Power Green Industries**. Its mission is to make practical Information Technology, Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Software Development education accessible and career-focused.

- **Website**: https://futureitindustry.com/
- **Legal Entity**: Power Green Industries
- **Registered Office**: 4, Varma House, Bakarpur, Bihar, PIN: 844127, India
- **Nature of Business**: Information Technology Education, Computer Training, AI & Software Development Courses, Technical Skill Certification, and Career Placement Preparation Services.

---

## 2. Public Course Catalog & Curriculum Summaries

> Note: Below are publicly available course overviews and curriculum summaries. Paid lesson media, full internal study packs, hidden assessment test cases, and answer keys are restricted to enrolled authenticated learners.

### 1. Data Analyst with GenAI

- **URL**: https://futureitindustry.com/courses/data-analyst-genai
- **Format**: Self-Paced Interactive + AI Mentor
- **Listed Price**: ₹1,199
- **Key Tools & Technologies**: Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel, ChatGPT
- **Target Career Roles**: Data Analyst | BI Consultant
- **Summary**: Master Python, SQL, Power BI, Excel & GenAI to build automated business dashboards.
- **Public Curriculum Overview**:
  - Data Analytics Foundations: Data vs Information vs Insight, analytics workflows, and business decision-making.
  - Python for Data Analysis: Variables, data types, control flow, functions, NumPy arrays, Pandas DataFrames, and Matplotlib visualizations.
  - SQL & Relational Databases: Filtering, aggregations, joins, CTEs, window functions, and analytical queries.
  - Microsoft Excel & Power BI: Formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, DAX measures, and executive business dashboards.
  - Generative AI for Analysts: Prompt workflows, automated insight summaries, and human-in-the-loop verification.

### 2. Data Science & Agentic AI

- **URL**: https://futureitindustry.com/courses/data-science-agentic-ai
- **Format**: Self-Paced Interactive + AI Mentor
- **Listed Price**: ₹1,299
- **Key Tools & Technologies**: Python, PyTorch, LangChain, Vector DB, RAG
- **Target Career Roles**: Data Scientist | AI Agent
- **Summary**: Build Machine Learning models, RAG pipelines, and autonomous AI Agent systems.
- **Public Curriculum Overview**:
  - Foundations & Python Programming: Core Data Science workflow, Python fundamentals, and structured problem solving.
  - Math, Statistics & Data Preparation: Descriptive statistics, probability, data cleaning, and exploratory data analysis.
  - NumPy, Pandas, SQL & Data Engineering: Structured data manipulation, querying, and analytical pipelines.
  - Machine Learning: Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and feature engineering.
  - Deep Learning & Generative AI: Neural networks, PyTorch foundations, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  - Agentic AI & Reliable AI Systems: Multi-step AI agents, tool calling, LangChain workflows, Vector DBs, and evaluation.
  - Deployment, Projects & Career Readiness: End-to-end capstones, portfolio building, and interview preparation.

## 3. Learning Experience & Platform Capabilities

### Interactive Visual Learning
Concepts are taught using structured visual learning sheets combining editorial diagrams, step-by-step concept flows, comparison cards, sample data tables, and highlighted code blocks rather than dense walls of text.

### AI Mentor & Bilingual Learning (English + Hindi)
Every structured visual lesson integrates an interactive AI Mentor supporting both English and Hindi (Hinglish) modes with synchronized audio-visual pacing so learners from diverse educational backgrounds can understand technical terminology clearly.

### Coding Practice & DSA
Dedicated hands-on coding practice tracks help learners build muscle memory in Python, SQL, Excel formulas, and Data Structures & Algorithms through structured problem sets.

### Multi-Format Topic Assessments
Topics include separate interactive practice layers:
- **MCQ Assessments**: Conceptual accuracy checks.
- **Puzzle Challenges**: Code and logic assembly exercises.
- **Real-World Challenges**: Applied business and engineering scenarios.

### Topic Interview & AI Mock Interviews
Learners can practice topic-specific technical interview questions as well as structured AI Mock Interviews and HR round preparation to improve communication clarity and technical confidence.

### ATS Resume Score Checker
Publicly accessible at https://futureitindustry.com/ats-resume-checker, enabling learners to evaluate resume structure, keyword coverage, and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) compatibility.

### Internship & Placement Preparation
Structured portfolio capstone projects, role-specific interview preparation tracks, and career readiness resources designed to help learners prepare for technical hiring processes.

---

## 4. Dedicated Learner Pathways

1. **Non-IT Background Learners**: Guided Zero-to-Job Foundation starting from core analytical thinking, spreadsheets, SQL, and beginner-friendly Python with bilingual support.
2. **Career Gap Professionals**: Skill Refresh & Portfolio pathway focused on modern industry tools (Python, SQL, Power BI, GenAI), practical capstones, ATS resume rebuilding, and mock interview practice.
3. **Freshers & College Students**: Structured end-to-end tracks combining conceptual visual notes, daily coding/DSA practice, real-world projects, and interview readiness.
4. **Career Switchers**: Fast-track transition pathways tailored for professionals moving into Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, AI Engineering, or Full Stack Web Development.

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (Public FAQ)

**Q: Who can join Future IT Industry courses?**
A: Courses are designed for beginners, college students, freshers, non-IT graduates, professionals returning after a career gap, and working professionals switching into IT, Data, and AI roles.

**Q: In which languages are lessons available?**
A: The platform supports bilingual learning with English and Hindi (Hinglish) explanations, making complex technical topics approachable for Indian learners.

**Q: Are there both self-paced and live instructor-led programs?**
A: Yes. Core career tracks (such as Data Analyst with GenAI, Data Science & Agentic AI, ML Engineering, AI Engineering, AI Tools & Prompt Engineering, MS Office 365 with Copilot, and Full Stack Web Development) offer structured interactive learning, while specialized builder programs (AI Website Builder Pro, AI App Builder Pro, and AI Video Creator Pro) are offered as live instructor-led classes.

**Q: Does Future IT Industry offer resume and interview preparation tools?**
A: Yes. The platform includes an ATS Resume Score Checker (https://futureitindustry.com/ats-resume-checker), topic-wise technical interview Q&A practice, AI-assisted mock interviews, and HR round preparation.

**Q: How can I contact Future IT Industry support?**
A: You can reach official support by phone at +91 8210778369, via WhatsApp at https://wa.me/917632099528, or by email at subodh.mscit@gmail.com. Support hours are Monday – Saturday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM IST; Sunday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM IST.

**Q: Where can I read official policies?**
